newsitem.title: SWEDEN: MODO SAYS H1 SAW HIGH VOLUMES, LOW PRICES.
newsitem.headline: MODO SAYS H1 SAW HIGH VOLUMES, LOW PRICES.

text.p: Swedish forestry group MoDo on Thursday posted a higher than expected profit for first half 1997, saying high volumes and low prices were the key factors and reporting a better second quarter mirroring its rivals.

MoDo, which was the last of Sweden's big forestry companies to report for the six months, posted a profit after financial items of 917 million crowns against 1.66 billion a year earlier. The market expected a profit of 884 million crowns.
MoDo said the second quarter was better than the first with a profit of 526 million crowns against 391 million in the first three months of the year.
"Continued good order intake, high delivery levels and generally stable price marked Modo's main product areas in the second quarter," MoDo said in a statement.
